title: Cancer patients at NHS trust harmed by years of unnecessary chemotherapy, report finds
summary_full: Trust apologises after findings on treatment of 20 brain tumour patients under oncologist who retired in 2023Cancer patients were severely harmed after being given years of unnecessary chemotherapy treatment by an NHS trust, a report has found.Some people were misdiagnosed and given inappropriate courses of treatment, while others were incorrectly told that if they stopped chemotherapy they would die, according to a Royal College of Physicians (RCP) report.
